title: Two-week Interview refresher
description: Fourteen flexible sessions of 75–90 minutes. Spread them over any number of days. Done means you chose to finish the activity; it is not a claim of mastery.
prerequisites: This is a refresher for someone who has programmed before. Start with lessons 1.1–1.2 if names, values or strings are unfamiliar. Each session lists the earlier concepts it uses. All lessons remain accessible.

sessions.title: Find your starting point
sessions.prerequisite: You have programmed before. If Python names, values or strings are new, start with lessons 1.1 and 1.2 first.

activities.title: Try the fundamentals diagnostic
activities.description: Work through the six untimed diagnostic problems. Record confidence and mistakes; help is available and does not imply mastery.

activities.title: Review the areas you identified
activities.description: Use the diagnostic review links below. A passing result can still deserve review when your confidence is low or you needed help.

activities.title: Choose your emphasis
activities.description: Record your target interview and two topics to revisit. Treat the sessions as flexible study blocks; take more than two weeks whenever useful.

sessions.title: A realistic CPE capstone
sessions.prerequisite: Parsing, aware dates, validation and collections from earlier sessions.

activities.title: Plan the stale device report
activities.description: Read the problem and tests. State assumptions and sketch parsing, validation and reporting stages.

activities.title: Build and test the report
activities.description: Implement the stale device report. Timebox the first attempt; use remaining time for edge cases and a clear explanation.

activities.title: Review the result
activities.description: Compare the reference solution after passing. Record one correctness issue and one maintainability improvement; revisit when unfinished.

sessions.title: Curated mock rounds and final review
sessions.prerequisite: Practise 5.4, 10.1, 11.1 and 12.1 in the earlier sessions. The mocks require fresh passes even if already solved.

activities.title: Set up your mock interview
activities.description: Choose a quiet block. State assumptions aloud and explain tradeoffs. Use the two focused 30-minute rounds below; advanced graph and LRU problems are outside this path.

activities.title: Mock A: collections and dates
activities.description: A fresh two-problem round drawn from this path: set reconciliation and aware timestamps. Finish the round before starting Mock B.

activities.title: Mock B: API basics and a hash map
activities.description: A second fresh two-problem round: request construction and two sum. Finish and review your result before marking the activity done.

activities.title: Choose your next practice
activities.description: Review both rounds while they are current: the interview tool retains only the latest finished result. Keep your takeaways here, revisit weak activities, and choose optional topics relevant to your target interview.
